verdict.rationale: LM Studio's docs describe a built-in chat interface for local models. The v0.3.0 notes add GUI chat features such as nested chat folders, regenerate with paging between generations, themes, and document attachment for offline RAG. Community users independently confirm "a UI to chat with models easily." Minor UI complaints (no clear empty state in the chatbox) do not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: in-depth current first-party documentation of the chat UI workflow beyond brief feature bullets and release notes.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can chat with local models using a built-in graphical chat interface

citations.quote: Use a simple and flexible chat interface
Download the latest local LLMs directly within the app and use them for simple chats or advanced agentic tasks.
Now clicking "regenerate" keeps previous message generations and you can easily page between them using a familiar arrow right / arrow left interface.
a UI to chat with models easily
